item: Same-clip direction vs speed probe counts, C.11 Adam recipe (ledger #178)

clips.split: splits/split_v1.json direction split restricted to these clips (scripts/run_sameclip.py restrict)

method.sequence: wm.inlp.adam_sequence (scripts/run_step2.py --recipe adam): C.11 Adam probe each round, QR, project out span(W_k); paper protocol
method.standardisation: per-feature z-score, stats from the restricted train rows

stop_rules.C11: K_first: direction R2 < 0.1 or circular MAE > 80 deg; speed R2 < 0.05 or MAE > 0.9 x mean-predictor MAE (l.1211-1212)
stop_rules.C11_patience: K_patience: start of the final 3-round C.11 at-chance run - 1 (stored Adam files' variant)
stop_rules.fig22: direction R2 < 0.3, speed R2 < 0.1 (Fig. 22 caption l.1172); censored = never crossed before the sequence stopped (K_fig22 then = K_patience, a floor)

method.K: probes kept; dims = 2K for direction (sin, cos), K for speed

runtime_note: sum of shard runtimes (shards ran in parallel, 1 BLAS thread each)

recipe.targets: standardised on train rows for training (mean, SD per column); probe and scores in physical units
